MDWC_WarcasketHelmet_Medic.description.english:
Specialized spacer-tech warcasket helmet with standard protection, fitted with a diagnostic visor that lets the mechanite dressing treat disease and infection as well as wounds.

A 10th-generation spacer chassis refitted for the medic's role: the pilot is welded in for good, like any warcasket wearer, but this one is built to keep the rest of the squad alive rather than to break the line.

The medic series trades firepower for the tools to treat wounds under fire, so a squad that fields one can stay in the fight long after its stims and bandages have run out.

MDWC_WarcasketTrait_Medic.degreeDatas.me.english: {PAWN_nameDef} is entombed in a medic warcasket. No amount of pain will have an effect on {PAWN_objective}, and {PAWN_pronoun} can never go into a pain shock or drop unconscious due to pain. The suit is built around treating the wounded, so {PAWN_nameDef} keeps the use of {PAWN_possessive} medical and social faculties; the bulk of the armor and the energy it takes to move it make it a poor fit for most other work.

MDWC_MechaniteDressing.description.english:
Stream medicine-laden mechanites onto a nearby person or animal to tend their wounds, most urgent first. Tend quality depends on the pilot's medical skill and the medicine used. If the medic helmet is worn, the mechanites also treat diseases and infections.

Each wound tended uses up medicine from the suite. The patient is held in place while the stream runs.
